Sam (People Ops): New compact 'Launchpad' checklist for managers to kick off week 0->1 + a minimal 30/60/90. Designed to be copy/paste into calendar & PR docs.

Nia: Love the name. Can you add clear owner notes for each item?

Sam (People Ops): Done. Manager = outcomes/context, Buddy = tools & day-to-day, People Ops = logistics/access.

Ethan: Please include a 1-line escalation path for access failures (Github/Okta/cloud). New hires get stuck too often.

Sam (People Ops): Added escalation lines. Also noted an async standup option for distributed teams.

OnboardBot: Laptop order queued (ETA 3 business days).

Sam (People Ops): Full single-page below (use as handout):

LAUNCHPAD: WEEK 0 (15-30m prep)
- Send welcome note + calendar invites (day0 logistics, day1 manager 1:1, team intro, buddy slot)
- Open access ticket: Okta, Slack, GitHub team, Drive, cloud role, badge if onsite
- Draft 3 target outcomes for first 90 days and attach to day1 1:1
- Choose buddy and confirm pairing availability for week1

DAY 1 (limit meetings to 3-4)
09:30-10:15 Manager 1:1 - role, scope, 90d targets, immediate priorities
11:00-11:30 Team intro - quick intros + org map (record link)
14:00-14:30 Buddy pair - env setup, run-first-app, first PR pairing
16:30-16:45 Manager wrap - pulse + confirm all access

DAYS 2-5
10:00 15min daily huddle (live or async) to surface blockers
Schedule 2 domain deep-dives: product + infra/dev loop

ACCESS CHECK (quick)
- Okta group added, Slack invite in place
- GitHub org membership + repo team assigned
- Drive folders shared (onboarding + team)
- Cloud read role assigned; request escalation for write access
- If any item missing >8hrs: DM @it-support -> cc @Sam

ESCALATION SUMMARY
- GitHub/org: @dev-platform (DM) -> @it-support if invite fails
- Okta/Slack: @it-support (DM)
- Cloud roles: @infra-ops (DM)

DAY 7 MANAGER CHECK (3 items)
- New hire opened or merged a PR with buddy guidance
- Buddy confirms env + test suite run pass
- Manager gave 30-day feedback & aligned next priorities

30/60/90 (one-line goals)
- 30d: onboarded & contributed (small fix/README)
- 60d: owns a feature or clear subsystem area
- 90d: leads an end-to-end deliverable with measurable outcome

SAMPLE TEMPLATES (copyable)
Manager welcome email:
"Hi {name}, welcome to Team X! Buddy: {buddy}. Day1 09:30-10:15 manager 1:1. Attached: 3x90 targets. Reply if you need a white-glove IT session"

Slack intro post:
"Welcome {name} to Team X as {role}! Buddy: {buddy}. Fun fact: {one-liner} :tada:"

Notes: record team intro for multi-timezone hires, offer async standup if needed. Managers: keep day1 light and focus on context + unblock access.
